name: Swarmkeeper
summary: A ranger accompanied by a swarm of nature spirits.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.short: Extra ranger spells you always know.
features.summary: You learn an additional spell at the listed ranger levels. They count as ranger spells for you but don't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.short: Once per turn, your swarm adds 1d6 damage, pushes or moves you.
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature, your swarm can: deal an extra 1d6 piercing, push the target 15 ft. (STR save), or move you 5 ft. without provoking.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.short: Learn Mage Hand (made of your swarm).
features.summary: You learn the Mage Hand cantrip; the hand looks like your swarm.

features.name: Writhing Tide
features.short: Bonus action: fly 10 ft. and hover for a minute.
features.summary: As a bonus action, your swarm lifts you: you gain a flying speed of 10 ft. and can hover for 1 minute. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Mighty Swarm
features.short: Swarm damage becomes 1d8; pushes knock prone; moving gives cover.
features.summary: Gathered Swarm deals 1d8 instead of 1d6, a push can also knock the target prone, and when you move yourself you gain half cover until your next turn.

features.name: Swarming Dispersal
features.short: Reaction: resist damage and teleport 30 ft.
features.summary: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to it and teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see. Uses: PB per long rest.
